subtitle_or_header:
Transform Sequence Elements in Parallel
[Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]

labels: Similarity (cream pill, blue text; repeated once per panel, 4x total)
Weighted SUM (cream pill, blue text; 4x total)
Dot Product (two-line label 'Dot' / 'Product' on tan box)
K,q (annotation with tiny arrow pointing into the Dot Product box)
K,q / √d (fraction annotation above the Scaling box)
Scaling by √d (vertical text inside pink box)
Soft max (vertical text inside pink box)
W^q (small red-bordered box at bottom of front panel)
q₁ [?] (output label of the bottom W^q box)
W^k [?] (blue box label, 4x per panel; tiny blurry superscript, could read W^q)
X (green cell letter inside every green dashed input box, many instances)
Y (green cell letter inside every green dashed output box)
equations: Σ (summation symbol in the pale-blue weighted-sum box)

layout.arrangement: Full-bleed light-gray slide enclosed by a thin dark-red rectangular frame with a thicker dark-red strip along the bottom edge. Three-line bold title block sits top-left-of-center. Yellow '39' ellipse at top-right. One large cascading diagram dominates the center: four identical peach rounded-rectangle panels overlapping in a diagonal stack from front-bottom-left to back-top-right, each panel containing the same self-attention pipeline. Four thick red up-arrows labeled X₁–X₄ enter from bottom-center; green dashed Y₁–Y₄ output boxes with red up-arrows exit along a rising diagonal at the panels' tops; a rotated yellow '*** Run in Parallel ***' sticker sits bottom-right.

layout.hierarchy: The peach panel stack dominates (~75% of canvas). Second in salience are the saturated red elements (X/Y labels, arrows, sticker text, ⊗ nodes). Title is bold but visually secondary to the diagram; the smallest text (≈7-9pt) is the pipeline labels inside panels. Yellow sticker and '39' ellipse are small but very high-contrast accents.

visual_elements.description: Front-panel self-attention pipeline (identical on all 4 panels). Left to right: (a) green dashed rounded box with 4 stacked pale-pink cells each holding a green letter 'X'; (b) four rows, each = small white box with blue border labeled 'W^k [?]' → 2-3 tiny pale-yellow cells (vector components) → label 'K₁ [?]'…'K₄ [?]'; (c) tan vertical rectangle 'Dot Product' containing ~8 blue dots of varying size linked by thin lines; label 'K,q' with a tiny arrow points into it; (d) fraction annotation 'K,q / √d'; (e) pink vertical rounded box with rotated text 'Scaling by √d'; (f) pink vertical rounded box with rotated text 'Soft max'; (g) pale-blue horizontal box 'Σ' at top right; (h) four red ⊗ (circle-cross) nodes in a vertical column below Σ, each fed from the right by labels 'V₁'…'V₄' and blue 'W^V' boxes that take input from a second green dashed box of four 'X' cells at the panel's right edge; thin red probability lines fan from 'Soft max' to each ⊗; each ⊗ feeds up into 'Σ'; (i) below the Dot Product box: small red-bordered box 'W^q' producing a cell labeled 'q₁ [?]' with a thin line up into the Dot Product box; (j) bottom of panel: horizontal green dashed box of 4 'X' cells with the first cell highlighted (pink fill, red border); dashed green arrow from this row up the left edge into the input 'X' box. Along the panel's top edge sit three cream pills with blue text: 'Similarity' (above Dot Product), 'Probabilities' (above Soft max), 'Weighted SUM' (above Σ).
visual_elements.position: center; front panel approx x 13%-71%, y 43%-91%

visual_elements.description: Four identical peach rounded-rectangle panels in a cascading stack; each panel behind is offset ≈ +7% right and ≈ -5% up relative to the one in front, representing the same computation run for X₁ (front) through X₄ (back). Rear panels are clipped by the panels in front; visible parts are their right-hand green 'X' boxes, W^V boxes, top pills ('Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM') and top output areas.
visual_elements.position: center, diagonally staggered from x 12% to x 95%

visual_elements.description: Four output groups along a rising diagonal at the panels' tops: each is a green dashed rounded box containing 4 pale cells with green 'Y' letters, with a thick red block up-arrow to a large red subscripted label. Order from lowest/leftmost to highest/rightmost: Y₁ (≈x 47-55%, y 33-40%), Y₂ (≈x 55-62%, y 28-34%), Y₃ (≈x 62-70%, y 22-29%), Y₄ (≈x 70-78%, y 18-25%).
Four thick red vertical block up-arrows along the bottom (x ≈ 31%, 40%, 50%, 59%), each labeled beneath in bold red with subscript: X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄; they feed the input row / panels from below.

Dot-product scatter inside the tan 'Dot Product' box: roughly 8 blue dots of varying diameters connected by thin gray lines (small mesh/network look), receiving lines from the K-vector cells and from q₁ below.
visual_elements.position: center-left of front panel, x ≈ 27%-33%, y ≈ 49%-75%

visual_elements.description: Dashed light-green connector curves: one from the bottom highlighted input row curving up the left side into the front panel's green 'X' box; a long dashed curve sweeping right and up with small green arrowheads entering the rear panels' right-hand 'X' boxes — indicating the same input sequence is distributed to all four parallel computations.
visual_elements.position: bottom-left curving across bottom and up the right side

visual_elements.description: Yellow sticker/banner rotated ≈ -8° (tilted up to the right) with bold red text '*** Run in Parallel ***'.
visual_elements.position: bottom-right, x 72%-92%, y 81%-92%, overlapping the panels' lower-right corner

visual_elements.description: Slide number badge: yellow ellipse with dark-red outline containing bold dark-red '39'.

imagery: No photographs, clip-art or illustrations; all visuals are flat vector-style schematic shapes (rounded panels, dashed boxes, small cells, block arrows, pills, dots, ⊗ symbols) in a hand-diagram lecture style.

colors.background: #EBEBEB (light gray; margin outside the frame slightly darker gray)
colors.body_text: #333333 (diagram labels; blue #1F3FBF for W-box and pill text; dark red #A02040 for vertical pink-box text)
accents: #CC0000 (red arrows, X/Y labels, ⊗ nodes, sticker text)
#00A651 (green dashed boxes and X/Y cell letters)

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title lines are bold with decreasing size (~20pt → 17pt → 15pt), center-aligned as a block; in line 3 the four X symbols are red with subscript digits. Diagram text is very small (≈7-9pt). 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max' are rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top) inside vertical pink boxes; 'Dot Product' is stacked on two lines. Heavy use of subscripts (X₁…X₄, Y₁…Y₄, K₁…K₄, V₁…V₄, q₁). Pill labels ('Similarity', 'Probabilities', 'Weighted SUM') in blue; 'SUM' in capitals. '*** Run in Parallel ***' is bold red on yellow, rotated ≈ -8°. Slide number bold dark red.
animation_state: No mid-build state: all four panels, all outputs Y₁–Y₄, all pills and all labels are fully visible simultaneously — a static figure deliberately showing everything at once (parallelism).
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide; fill background light gray #EBEBEB. 2. Draw a dark-red (#9E3D3D) rectangle outline (~2pt) inset ~4% from every edge; add a solid dark-red bar ~3% tall across the full bottom edge. 3. Title block centered around x≈33% of slide width starting y≈8%: line 1 'Parallel Processing' (Arial Bold 20pt black); line 2 'Transform Sequence Elements in Parallel' (Arial Bold 17pt black); line 3 '[Calculation of Self Attention of words ( X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄)]' (Arial Bold 15pt black, with the four X's red #CC0000 and digits subscripted). 4. Top-right: yellow #FFFF00 ellipse ~0.55"×0.35" with dark-red 1.5pt outline, bold dark-red '39' 14pt. 5. Build the FRONT PANEL: rounded rectangle ~5.6"×2.5" at (x 13%, y 43%), fill peach #FCE4C8, 1pt tan #E0B080 outline. 6. Inside, left: green dashed (#00A651, dashed 1.5pt) rounded box ~0.5"×1.2" holding 4 stacked cells (fill #F9D5E5, thin gray outline), each with bold green 'X' 8pt. 7. To its right, 4 rows: each row = white box 0.35"×0.22" with blue 1pt outline and blue 7pt text 'W^k' (superscript k; original blurry, may be W^q) → 3 tiny cells fill #FFF6BF → blue 7pt label 'K₁'/'K₂'/'K₃'/'K₄'. 8. Center-left: vertical tan #D2A26A rectangle ~0.55"×1.5" with dark-red 8pt text 'Dot' / 'Product' at top; scatter ~8 blue #1F4FBF dots (3-5pt) inside, connected by thin gray lines. Add label 'K,q' 7pt with a tiny arrow into this box. 9. Above the next column place the fraction 'K,q' over '√d' (7pt with fraction bar). 10. Two vertical pink #F7C9D4 rounded boxes ~0.3"×1.1" with 90°-rotated dark-red 8pt text 'Scaling by √d' and 'Soft max'. 11. Top-right of panel: pale-blue #C9DFF5 rectangle ~0.9"×0.25" with black 'Σ' 12pt. Below it a vertical column of 4 red ⊗ symbols (red circle outline with red ×, ~0.15"); each ⊗ connects up into Σ; to each ⊗'s right place label 'V₁'…'V₄' (7pt) and a blue-bordered white box 'W^V' 7pt; draw lines from a second green dashed 4-cell 'X' box at the panel's right edge into the W^V boxes; fan thin red lines from 'Soft max' to each ⊗. 12. Below the Dot Product box: small white box with red 1pt outline, red 7pt 'W^q', followed by a tiny #FFF6BF cell labeled 'q₁' 7pt; thin line from q₁ up into the Dot Product box. 13. Panel bottom: horizontal green dashed box ~2.2"×0.3" with 4 cells — cell 1 fill #F9D5E5 with red 1.5pt outline and green 'X' (highlighted), cells 2-4 white with green 'X'. Dashed green arrow from this row's left end curving up into the left 'X' box. 14. Panel top edge: three cream #FFFDE7 pills ~0.55"×0.18" with blue 7pt text: 'Similarity' above Dot Product, 'Probabilities' above Soft max, 'Weighted SUM' above Σ. 15. Group the entire panel; duplicate 3×; offset each copy +0.65" right and -0.25" up; z-order so panel 1 (X₁) is frontmost and panel 4 (X₄) rearmost — rear panels will be naturally clipped. 16. Outputs: above each panel's top-right place a green dashed box of 4 cells with green 'Y' letters; from each box draw a thick red block up-arrow to a red bold 14pt subscripted label: Y₁ (x≈50%, y≈33%), Y₂ (57%, 28%), Y₃ (65%, 23%), Y₄ (73%, 18%). 17. Bottom: four thick red block up-arrows (~0.25"×0.5") at x≈31%, 40%, 50%, 59%, y≈88-93%; beneath each a red bold 14pt subscripted label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄. 18. Draw a dashed light-green (#A5D6A7) curved connector from the bottom input row sweeping right and up, with small green arrowheads entering the rear panels' right 'X' boxes. 19. Bottom-right: yellow #FFFF00 rectangle ~2"×0.45" rotated -8° with bold red 14pt text '*** Run in Parallel ***'. 20. Verify all text matches the verbatim lists above (including subscripts via PowerPoint subscript formatting) and colors match the hex values given.
